verdict.rationale: The docs describe Trigger.dev as a platform for durable, long-running tasks with no execution timeout. Waitpoint tokens and triggerAndWait pause runs until they are resumed, and approval waits keep the run alive. The durable chat tasks are documented as surviving deploys and crashes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-day waits (e.g. duration-based waits), a general description of how state is checkpointed and restored across worker or platform restarts for ordinary tasks (the restart-survival claim appears only for AI chat), and independent hands-on corroboration; the one community comment touching this topic is an older wish for wait/resume rather than a report on the current feature.
